verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a hosted public cloud. Self-hosting the platform is a fair question for a PaaS, since some deployment platforms ship self-hostable editions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Fly.io (Machines, flyd, Sprites) can be installed or run on the user's own infrastructure. The evidence describes running user apps and MCP servers on Fly's infrastructure, which is not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
